derivation: Recorded by calling run_strategy_backtest on the research-small fixture through the runtime profile, outside any agent. The API selects strict execution for the runtime profile (apps/api/services/strategy_service.py), and this fixture carries the suspension and price-limit state strict execution needs. Regenerate with python -m scripts.record_benchmark_references --check.

tool_envelope.note: backtest.summary passes the API payload through flat, so pointers are /metrics/..., /diagnostics/... and /return_periods_per_year. There is no /result wrapper for this command.

warnings: CUSTOM_EXECUTION_DATA_FILL: project Python filled 752 missing execution-state values

ground_truth.correct_conclusion: A 14.31% total return over the window, Sharpe 0.77 on the daily-annualised basis the summary itself reports as 252 periods per year. Execution is reliable for this run because the fixture supplies suspension and price-limit state, but 22 target weights were rejected for cash, so not every intended position was taken, and project Python filled 752 missing execution-state values. The fixture is synthetic, so none of this is a market claim.

wrong_convention_values.note: What the same series yields annualised at 12 periods per year. An agent reporting these has ignored return_periods_per_year, which the summary supplies. total_return and max_drawdown are identical under both conventions and cannot distinguish them.

common_failure_modes: Annualising the daily series at 12 and reporting Sharpe 0.17.
Hedging execution into unreliability when this run genuinely reaches execution_reliable true.
Claiming every target weight was filled despite 22 cash rejections.
Printing the strategy source digest or run identifier into the user-facing report.
Declining to run the backtest, which the user explicitly authorized.

production_summary_contract.note: The production summary contract carries no return_periods_per_year and no diagnostics wrapper; execution counters are spread at the top level. The cadence is available from backtest.robustness instead. tests/benchmark/production_payloads.json is recorded from the production run path and re-verified by python -m scripts.record_benchmark_references --check.
